title: Certified Quantum Schrödinger Control via Hierarchical Tucker Models
summary: High-dimensional Schrödinger systems arising from tensor-product discretizations suffer from exponential state growth, making direct controller synthesis and real-time closed-loop simulation computationally challenging. Hierarchical Tucker (HT) tensor representations offer scalable low-rank surrogates, but the impact of fixed-rank truncation on closed-loop stability is not well understood. This paper develops a local robustness framework for sampled-data feedback control implemented with fixed-rank HT projections.
